_comment: Blocks an Age's rock may not be made of, though their shape says they could -- see `Materials`. The
shape rule asks whether a block is a whole cube you cannot fall through, and cannot ask whether it
Leaves are the whole of it so far: a full cube with no block entity, which decays wherever no log
stands near, so a world of them would evaporate shortly after it was written.
This wins over `valid_for_terrain` where a block is somehow in both, because a refusal is the safe
way to read an authoring mistake.
